Member root-email change is a candidate only: AWS requires management/delegated-admin context, trusted access and new-email OTP; root MFA or centralized credential recovery may block root sign-in. Contact changes affect recovery data but do not establish another IAM principal. No proven account-admin edge yet.

CreateToken Studio login and PassRole app-role routes are cataloged. GetToken is application-plane only; variable/log reads have no verified AWS credential. Existing-role UpdateApp/UpdateBranch build routes need branch, job-scope and code-execution evidence; marked as candidates rather than inferred role edges.

API keys, REST integration changes and authorizer replacement affect API calls or application authorization. PutIntegration with PassRole permits API Gateway to invoke a Lambda but does not give the caller the integration or Lambda role. No exact AWS-principal transition is documented on this page.

External-source profile with a passed RetrievalRoleArn can expose source configuration bytes through AppConfig Data, but no exact usable AWS credential or new principal is observed. This is a delegated read and remains outside the principal escalation map.

CreateService/PassRole, UpdateService/PassRole and existing-role UpdateService routes are cataloged; the latter now joins the exact service and InstanceRoleArn. DescribeService plaintext variables are disclosure unless an exact usable IAM credential is established. Mutable private-ECR tag auto-deployment is a candidate pending exact image tag, auto-deploy and repository-write join to the service role.
Existing running DESKTOP fleet and both RUNNING builder role-session routes are cataloged and tested. Application update and other sections still need individual review.

Self-contained CreateGraphqlApi, schema, HTTP data source, resolver and API-key path is cataloged with exact PassRole and global setup grants. Existing API, UpdateDataSource and UpdateResolver variants need a collected callable field, data-source role and usable caller authorization. Other resolver changes are application data effects, not an exact IAM role transition.

Existing calculation, Spark Connect endpoint and notebook URL routes restored using session-specific execution role, active state, compatible engine and exact action scope. New and stored-query headings still need individual review; tests/test_peaso_privesc_athena_sessions.py.
UpdateNotebook can change stored code; no collected notebook-to-workgroup join or later execution event currently proves role reach. Other stored-query sections still need review.

DbConnectAdmin authorizes the source IAM identity to use a database admin role; PutClusterPolicy can grant that same source identity the database connect action. Both affect one Aurora DSQL cluster or its PostgreSQL privileges, not another AWS IAM principal or general AWS API authority. Keep as bounded database-access findings, not principal-to-principal edges; AWS Aurora DSQL resource-policy and authentication docs.

PassRole registration and existing-definition SubmitJob routes are active. Existing definition uses exact role and revision plus a valid EC2 queue; mutable ECR tag and other page sections still require individual review.

CreateCodeInterpreter, CreateAgentRuntime, CreateHarness and UpdateAgentRuntime are active but still need current sign-off on generated resource scopes, code source, lifecycle and full composite permissions. Existing READY code interpreters and harnesses have collectable exact execution-role joins through GetCodeInterpreter/GetHarness; marked candidates until CSPM adds safe inventory and scoped invocation checks. Prompt-injection shell route remains conditional on model behavior.

Existing Code Interpreter execution-role pivot is a collectable candidate via List/GetCodeInterpreter, READY status and exact Start/Invoke grants. CreateAgentRuntime/PassRole and Lambda action-group hijack have active entries but require current artifact, runtime and agent-to-function invocation joins for sign-off. The Lambda code-change action alone does not prove the agent will invoke that function.

The sole CreateJob/PassRole route is plausible but not signed off. AWS authorizes CreateJob on both a selected device and the service-generated job ARN, while the current wildcard probe can match only one scoped permission. A runnable controlled S3 script or image, role read access, output write path, enabled service and usable device are not joined. Add exact authorization and artifact witnesses before reporting role reach; AWS Braket Service Authorization Reference, CreateJob API and Hybrid Jobs guide.

CreateBudgetAction with a passed budgets execution role can attach an IAM policy, apply an SCP or run an SSM document only after an existing budget action reaches its trigger or is approved. The role performs bounded chosen operations, not arbitrary role access. A self-admin policy attachment needs exact existing-budget, trigger, execution-role attach permission and controlled target-principal evidence before an IAM permission-grant path; AWS Budgets controls and CreateBudgetAction docs.

PassRole and channel-configuration creation alone do not prove the source controls an authorized Slack/Teams channel or can invoke commands there. Channel guardrails can also narrow the passed role. The sole documented IAM-role route remains a candidate pending workspace, channel, user access and guardrail evidence; AWS Chatbot API and IAM docs.

GetResource/ListResources can use a passed resource-handler role to read a supported resource, but the returned data is bounded to that resource operation. It does not give the caller the role or another AWS principal. Keep as delegated data exposure; AWS Cloud Control resource-operation and IAM docs.

CreateResource with a passed CloudFormation role is cataloged for the exact IAM user creation path: the role must create, read, set a login profile and grant administrator permissions to one unused user. UpdateResource and other resource types need their own exact handler and target outcome; the generic RoleArn alone is insufficient. AWS Cloud Control CreateResource API and supported resource docs.

The subpage demonstrates the same PassRole+CreateStack service-role route as aws-cloudformation-passrole-createstack. DescribeStacks retrieves stack outputs; it grants no new role authority and is not a separate edge. The active route still needs a recorded privilege-changing template effect or explicit unknown when target role permissions are insufficient; current CloudFormation precondition alone does not prove that effect (AWS CreateStack/AccessKey template docs).

Distribution redirects and CloudFront Functions affect application traffic but do not run as another IAM principal. The Lambda@Edge PassRole route is cataloged with dual service trust, versioned function actions, a usable distribution and service-linked-role readiness; deployment and traffic remain conditions. AWS Lambda@Edge permissions guide.

GetSpaceCredentialsForOrganization can return member-account credentials only for a management/delegated administrator with access to an existing member space. The vended session is space-scoped; exact target role and authority require domain, space, dataAccessRoleArn and access-grant joins missing from CSPM. Create/UpdateView expands telemetry access only, not an IAM principal. AWS CloudWatch Omni API and IAM docs.

Publishing a new package version may lead to code execution under a later consuming build or application role. Publication itself does not start execution, and exact pins or lockfiles can prevent selection. A principal edge needs a recorded package-to-consumer dependency, compatible version selection, future install/build trigger and exact consumer role; no deterministic route from package-write permission alone.

PollForJobs and GetJobDetails can return STS artifact credentials for a custom-action job, so two retired routes remain principal-session candidates rather than being dismissed as mere data reads. A dependable edge needs an actual matching job or known job ID, credentials issuance, their exact AWS subject and effective permissions beyond the caller; none follows from IAM permission alone.

The CreateProject+AssociateTeamMember project-owner path is historical. AWS lists CodeStar in full shutdown, meaning the APIs are no longer a current usable route; keep the page as historical documentation and do not add an active CSPM escalation technique (AWS Services in Full Shutdown).

UpdateUserAttributes changes only attributes the app client permits for the authenticated Cognito user. A mutable custom:isAdmin field may alter application authorization only if the consuming application trusts it; the page gives no join to an AWS IAM identity pool role or another principal. Email/username changes are likewise bounded to application login.

The existing scoped-grant route covers exact Connect Cases tag-conditioned self-permission. TagResource or UntagResource can change tags that condition specific Cases actions, but the resulting authority is confined to those case/domain/field resources and matching policy conditions. No second AWS principal or general role transition is shown.

Account Factory provisioning or update can create an Identity Center user in a new or existing managed account, but a role edge requires source control of that user, its exact assignment and account. AFC can deploy a blueprint in member accounts through CloudFormation, but the hub product, template control, baseline, target account and deployment role permissions must be joined. Neither page claim is an unconditional principal pivot; the retired Account Factory update remains a candidate.
The page says the passed role only performs bounded integrations, exports and event delivery; inspect each linked operation for another IAM principal.

DLM CreateLifecyclePolicy+PassRole can run a selected SSM Command document on a matching managed EC2 instance through a DLM role; it can reach a more privileged instance role only if the exact document, target tags, running/managed instance and DLM role SSM permissions align. No active YAML route exists; aws-dlm-passrole-lifecyclepolicy-scripts is a candidate pending this cross-service join. Snapshot sharing alone is data access, not a principal pivot (AWS DLM pre/post-script flow).

UpdateCluster can replace a DocumentDB Elastic cluster's database administrator password when it uses PLAIN_TEXT authentication. Database login additionally needs the endpoint, user name and network path. This can affect database data but does not yield an AWS IAM principal or AWS API permissions.
The page lists snapshot block reads and snapshots; inspect whether any documented step gives another IAM principal rather than data access.

The page has one policy-mutation route: PutFileSystemPolicy can name the same IAM user and grant exact ClientMount, covered by aws-efs-putfilesystempolicy-self-grant with accepted policy and before/after authorization evidence. DeleteFileSystemPolicy restores default NFS access but does not identify another IAM principal; mounting still needs network path and NFS authorization. Access-point and mount-target references are context, not additional principal pivots (AWS EFS IAM/NFS policy docs).

ModifyUser changes a Valkey/Redis user password or access string. That is an ElastiCache database identity and permissions, not an AWS IAM principal or general AWS API role. Keep as database access; AWS ElastiCache ModifyUser API.
Existing-cluster AddJobFlowSteps now joins the collected cluster instance profile to its exact IAM role. Other EMR privilege-escalation sections still need individual review.
The page points to a bounded workflow-role data export; verify the linked operation has no general role credential or code execution path.

StartPipe has only a pipe name and starts its already stored source, enrichment and target. Even with source records, the caller does not receive the execution role or select an arbitrary AWS API action. Retired role-target claim remains excluded; a bounded target effect would need separate configuration and trigger joins.

CreatePipe or UpdatePipe plus iam:PassRole can cause Pipes to perform configured supported source/enrichment/target operations under the passed role. It does not give the caller the full role session; exact effects depend on a valid source, target, records and role permissions. The retired generic role edge remains excluded as an overclaim.

AdminShell can reach credentials only on a live session that already has RoleArn; an arbitrary stream group does not prove such a session. StartStreamSession/CreateStreamUrl with PassRole additionally need a controlled associated application, active compatible group with capacity, exact group/application grants, role trust and request conditions. AWS requires the group to be created after July 16, 2026; current active YAML does not enforce this and remains older-review only (AWS GameLift Streams session-credential constraints/API).

StartRun plus exact iam:PassRole can run a private workflow under a selected HealthOmics service role; controlled workflow code would make this a role-code path. The retired entry lacks that control join. CreateWorkflow accepts a supplied definition ZIP, but a runnable image in private ECR or configured upstream cache, run-resource authorization, output location and successful execution remain conditions; import/export jobs are bounded data transfers.
The page separates billing rights and disclosure from IAM role escalation; check each linked bounded operation.

The page documents a new or repointed IoT role alias, a generated or self-registered certificate, and a policy permitting AssumeRoleWithCertificate. The new-alias/new-policy/new-certificate branch is active with both certificate alternatives and exact PassRole service context. Repointing an existing alias or reusing a certificate/policy still needs exact alias, certificate and policy joins; these are not inferred from API grants alone. Detection and CloudTrail sections are not independent principal routes.

The self-contained new-alias/new-policy route is active for both generated and self-registered certificates. Existing alias, pre-existing policy and already-held certificate variants need exact resource joins before they can report another IAM role. ProvisioningTemplate plus CreateProvisioningClaim creates device certificates, but reaches an IAM role only through a proven alias and IoT policy; the existing-alias principal-attestation entry stays conditional until that chain is collected. RegisterCertificateWithoutCA alone is device enrollment, not a second IAM principal.

Existing aws-sitewise-createaccesspolicy-portal-self-grant covers an exact reviewed portal self-grant; the wider controlled-identity variant lacks an identity-control join. SiteWise Monitor grants access to portal/project operational data through its portal role, not an IAM identity-policy grant to another principal; legacy enrollment and actual portal access remain conditions.
Connector invocation and PassRole may execute service work; inspect exact connector, controllable input and target role before deciding.

All six routes grant bounded IVS media publishing, playback, stage participation, token signing or composition effects. Stream keys and ingest credentials are IVS media credentials; recording/storage reads name S3 destinations but do not grant object access. No heading yields AWS IAM credentials or a new IAM grant; AWS IVS GetStreamKey API and HackTricks IVS post-exploitation page.

CreateChannel and AssociateStreamsWithChannel use a passed service role to deliver selected stream records to S3 or S3 Tables. The caller receives bounded data through a configured destination, not the role or a new IAM permission. No principal-to-principal route on this page; AWS Kinesis CreateChannel API.
Create/UpdateBot with PassRole and an existing hook need an exact code and role join before exclusion or restoration.

The reveal-sample integrity bypass concerns access to sensitive data samples. It does not identify a new AWS credential subject or grant the caller another IAM principal. Keep as data exposure, not a principal transition; AWS Macie sensitive-data sample guide.
The page describes a Fabric network invitation; verify this does not grant an AWS IAM principal.

Running Studio presigned-URL route is cataloged with exact application-to-role join. Existing streaming application code-update route is a candidate; it needs a collected code pointer, source write access, target role read access and an execution transition.

Describe/List/Rotate expose or replace MediaPackage v1 HLS ingest credentials. They can affect media input when an endpoint is reachable but do not yield AWS IAM credentials, policy authority, or another AWS principal. All four routes are already classified as bounded post-exploitation operations.
The page describes a MemoryDB ACL password change; check the separate IAM-auth path before excluding an AWS principal transition.

The active workflow-step route can execute a script on an SSM-managed instance and may reach that instance's IAM role. Current CSPM precondition always returns unknown because it collects no exact workflow graph/state, script control, service-linked role or target join; the YAML is conditional, not a verified edge. Existing customer enrollment is also required. Collector and precondition work remains.

The active custom automation-unit PassRole route can run a controlled SSM Automation document or Lambda under an exact role. Current CSPM precondition always returns unknown: no home-Region/preview availability, source-controlled runtime target or unit-to-role run join is collected. Its IAM grants alone cannot prove execution; collector and precondition work remains.
The page describes MSK security changes and topic access; verify no IAM principal grant follows.

UpdateAutonomousDatabase can reset the Oracle ADMIN credential and alter connection controls. The resulting authority is Oracle database access, not another AWS IAM principal. Keep as database access; AWS Oracle Database@AWS API.

CreateAccessPolicy or UpdateAccessPolicy can add a named persistent principal to OpenSearch Serverless collection/index data policies. Those policies authorize OpenSearch data operations and are separate from IAM identity grants. Network reach and a usable principal still matter; no IAM principal-to-principal route is established by this page.

PutResourcePolicy can grant same-account key operations to its writer or a named role, and UpdateAlias can redirect an existing alias-scoped key permission. These change access to a key only; neither provides another IAM principal or general AWS authority. Key state, usage and explicit denies further bound impact.
The page points to plugin action/data changes; inspect the linked plugin operation for any exact service-role or credential path.

RegisterUser self-IAM-user route is active and conditional on QuickSight subscription. UpdateUser can set an existing QuickSight user's role to ADMIN, but the retired path needs an exact source-controlled target user and sign-in join; otherwise it only changes another application identity's role. Neither grants IAM administrator permissions.

CreateTest and StartTestRun can drive a selected managed FIS test template through a passed execution role on a compatible service. The template, service topology, setup, role and downstream permissions bound actions to predefined faults; the caller does not receive the role or general API authority. Treat as operational disruption, not a full-role principal edge.

UpdateView changes the filter on an existing view and may broaden metadata visible to existing Search/ListResources consumers within the view's scope. It does not change their IAM grants or create access to another principal; excluded as bounded reconnaissance.

GetDomainDetail discloses registration contacts, RetrieveDomainAuthCode returns a transfer credential, and TransferDomainToAnotherAwsAccount moves domain registration only after the receiving account accepts with the returned password. None grants control of an AWS IAM principal; AWS Route 53 Domains transfer API.

S3 Express CreateSession vends credentials confined to the caller's authorized directory bucket and mode; S3 Access Grants GetDataAccess vends credentials only for a matching grant and target. The credential tuple is a way to use already granted S3 data access, not evidence of a different IAM principal with additional general authority. Existing exclusion is appropriate.

CreateFileSystem plus PassRole can connect a bucket to an S3 Files service role whose permissions cover that bucket or prefix. Access still needs a working mount target, network path and file permissions, and only exposes the role's S3 data path; it does not yield the role session or its unrelated IAM rights. Retired full-role edge remains excluded.

PutTablePolicy and PutTableBucketPolicy can grant the policy writer or another named subject table permissions within the exact table or bucket scope. This is bounded S3 Tables resource authorization, not a route to another IAM principal or general AWS role authority; explicit denies and other service policies still apply.

PutVectorBucketPolicy can grant the writer or another named subject vector-index operations under the bucket. This changes bounded S3 Vectors resource permissions only; it does not grant another IAM principal or unrelated AWS authority, and explicit denies/KMS requirements remain.

GetSecretValue alone is secret read, not proof of another AWS principal. PutResourcePolicy can grant the same IAM user exact GetSecretValue on a secret; active aws-secretsmanager-putresourcepolicy-self-grant requires accepted policy, prior denial, effective grant and KMS decrypt evidence. GetResourcePolicy/ListSecrets are enumeration conveniences, DeleteResourcePolicy is cleanup, and credential contents cannot be inferred from permission to read (AWS Secrets Manager resource-policy docs).

AddPermission grants an AWS account bounded queue actions, not a named IAM role. SetQueueAttributes can replace an exact queue policy to name a controlled same-account IAM user and grant ReceiveMessage where that user lacked it; this is a principal permission-gain candidate missing from active YAML. Require exact queue ARN/URL, writer and recipient identity, effective before/after access including explicit denies and KMS decrypt for encrypted messages. Cross-account recipients also need IAM allow (AWS SQS policy and SetQueueAttributes docs).

The page contains eleven viable Identity Center role or permission-set mutation candidates: password reset, group membership, existing/new user assignment, managed/customer/inline policy changes, boundary removal, and new set creation. Every role-reach route needs a source-controlled usable directory identity and an exact permission-set/account/role join; edits to existing assigned sets also need successful ProvisionPermissionSet. The current YAML has no active sso.yaml entries, so these remain a real coverage gap rather than confirmed role edges. GetRoleCredentials is a bounded read and rogue token issuer is an application access route; AWS CreateAccountAssignment and ProvisionPermissionSet APIs.

Definition-only UpdateStateMachine on a recorded existing role is a possible missing route; exact role attachment is collected, but the iam:PassRole authorization requirement for unchanged roles needs verification.

AssumeRole is active; SAML/WebIdentity require externally controlled assertions, GetFederationToken keeps the caller's rights, and GetWebIdentityToken targets external services. Roles Anywhere CA replacement and new anchor/profile routes are active. Two AssumeRoot and two existing-profile Roles Anywhere variants are candidates with exact organization, task-policy, certificate, profile and trust joins still missing; none supports a full-role edge from API grants alone. AWS AssumeRoot, UpdateProfile and DeleteAttributeMapping APIs.

AssignAdminPermissionsToUser makes a selected IAM Identity Center user a Supply Chain application administrator only. The page explicitly limits this to the web application and gives no AWS IAM role, Identity Center permission set or AWS-account action. No principal-to-principal AWS authority edge follows from the documented operation; retain as service-level permission escalation, not a privesc path (AWS Supply Chain service authorization reference).

CreateScheduledQuery with PassRole runs chosen SQL and configured downstream writes under a service role but returns no role session or IAM grant. ExecuteScheduledQuery runs an existing ARN with stored SQL and destination; it cannot select arbitrary role actions. Both are bounded data/workflow effects, not exact principal transitions; AWS CreateScheduledQuery and ExecuteScheduledQuery APIs.

Create/UpdatePolicy, template changes, identity-source changes and alias rebinding affect Cedar decisions made by a consuming application. An AWS principal transition would need separate evidence that the application maps those decisions to a specific AWS role or operation; no such exact join is on this page. Routes remain bounded application authorization.

CreateDataRetentionBotChallenge resets the password for a Wickr network retention bot. An attacker-operated bot could receive messages if retention is enabled and enrollment succeeds, but it is a Wickr application identity, not an IAM role. The page has no exact AWS principal-to-principal path; AWS CreateDataRetentionBotChallenge API.

CreateUser, AddResourcePermissions and UpdateUser affect WorkDocs users and content. UpdateUser can set a WorkDocs user to ADMIN, but no link to a source-controlled login or AWS IAM principal is shown. The archived generic aws_role claim overstates a site-administration change; routes remain bounded to WorkDocs.
This page redirects to the canonical AppStream page; reconcile its session takeover routes there.

PassRole plus CreateSchedule can direct a Scheduler-trusting role to a supported target; existing aws-scheduler-passrole-createschedule-or-updateschedule models it. Current CSPM lacks scheduler schedule inventory, so the UpdateSchedule variant cannot be proven from permission alone, and the CreateSchedule variant needs one same-Region creatable schedule and a target action that the role can perform. The active technique remains older-review only pending exact precondition/target-effect validation (AWS Scheduler CreateSchedule/UpdateSchedule and universal targets docs).
